portada.subtitol: High-end bikes from our shop, by the day or by the hour, and a workshop that keeps yours in shape. Book in two minutes, in your language.

anatomia.titol: We take it apart, piece by piece.
anatomia.intro: A high-end road bike like the ones we fix every day. Scroll down to see what each part does, what you gain by upgrading it and how we keep it in shape.
anatomia.missatgeWhatsapp: Hi! I'd like to upgrade: {peca}. What do you recommend?
anatomia.sr: A red road bike comes apart piece by piece on a mountain road: wheels, brakes, drivetrain, handlebar, saddle and finally the bare frame.

rodes.funcio: They're the only thing touching the road: the tyre decides grip, and the wheel how much energy each pedal stroke loses.
rodes.potencial: lighter wheels and tubeless tyres make the bike livelier on climbs and safer in corners. It's the upgrade you feel the most.

frens.funcio: Hydraulic disc brakes stop the bike with two fingers, rain or shine.
frens.potencial: new pads and rotors stop you sooner, without squealing, so you take corners with more confidence.

transmissio.funcio: Chainring, chain, cassette and derailleur carry the power from your legs to the rear wheel.
transmissio.potencial: a healthy chain and cassette shift without skipping or noise. A worn chain eats the cogs: replacing it on time is far cheaper.

direccio.funcio: Handlebar, stem and levers: you steer, shift and brake from here.
direccio.potencial: good bar tape and a bar sized for you take strain off your hands and shoulders on long rides.

seient.funcio: Saddle and seatpost set the height and setback you pedal from.
seient.potencial: with the saddle set just right you pedal stronger and without knee or back pain.

quadre.funcio: The heart of the bike, where everything joins. A carbon frame is stiff where you push and comfortable where it should absorb.
quadre.potencial: a full service checks it inside and out and leaves every part adjusted like day one.

talla.p: How do I know my size?
talla.r: When you book we ask your height and suggest a size. At the shop we fine-tune saddle height and handlebar position.

pedals.p: Can I bring my own pedals?
pedals.r: Of course. We also have flat, Shimano SPD, SPD-SL and Look pedals so you don't have to pack yours.

fianca.r: We ask for an ID card or passport and a card deposit, refunded when you return the bike*.

cancel.r: Yes, free of charge up to 48 hours before collection*.

hotel.p: Do you deliver to my hotel?
hotel.r: We deliver to hotels in Calonge, Platja d'Aro and Palamós for two bikes or more*.

taller.p: How long does the workshop take?
taller.r: A service or a puncture is usually same day or next day. We give you the turnaround when you drop it off and message you on WhatsApp.

peu.lema: Bike rental, workshop and shop on the Costa Brava for over 15 years.
